ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT ("Agreement") dated as of December 17 , 2020, by and between THE RECTOR, CHURCH WARDENSANDVESTRYMENOFTHECHURCHOFTHEREDEEMER(a/K/aTHE RECTOR, CHURCH WARDENS AND VESTRYMEN OF THE CHURCH OF THE REDEEMER, IN THE VILLAGE OF ASTORIA,IN THE COUNTY OF QUEENS), a New York religious corporation, having an address at 30-14 Crescent Street, Astoria, New York 11102("TRANSFEROR")and ASTORIA CRESCENT OWNER LLC,a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at 242-15 Alameda Avenue, Douglaston, New York 11362 ("TRANSFEREE"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Transferor is the owner of fee title of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City and State of New York, in the County of Queens, known as and by the street address 30-14 Crescent Street, Astoria, NewYork and more particularly described in Exhibit A-1 annexed hereto and made a part hereof, and known as Block 572, Lot 1 on the New York City Tax Map, Borough of Queens (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as"TRANSFEROR'S LAND"and the buildings and improvements thereon together with any future replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as "TRANSFEROR'SBUILDING"andTRANSFEROR'S LAND and TRANSFEROR'S BUILDING being referred to hereinafter referred to as "TRANSFEROR'S PROPERTY"); and WHEREAS,Transferee is the owner of fee title to a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City and State of New York, County of Queens, known as and by the street address 30-12 Crescent Street,Astoria,NewYork,and more particularly described in Exhibit A-2 annexed hereto and made a part hereof, and also known as Block 572,Lot 44on the NewYork City Tax Map for the Borough of Queens, (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as "TRANSFEREE'S LAND"and the buildings and improvements thereon, together with any future replacement thereof being hereinafter referred to as"TRANSFEREE'S BUILDING,[or"TRANSFEREE'S NEW BUILDINGJand Transferee's Land and Transferee's Building being hereinafter referred to as “TRANSFEREE'S PROPERTY");and WHEREAS,Transferor's Land and Transferee's Land are located on a single zoning lot (the“ZONING LOT") as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (the “Zoning Resolution"), the existence of which is been confirmed by the recording of a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration') simultaneously herewith; and WHEREAS, Transferee intends to demolish the buildings and other improvements on Transferee's Land and construct thereon a new building, (the new building and improvements, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement,are herein collectively referred to as the “TRANSFEREE'S NEW BUILDING"or"New Building"); WHEREAS,Transferor's Building,does not use all of thefloor area development rights as defined hereinafter, appurtenant to Transferor's Land, if considered a separate zoning lot, so that the Subject Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to and utilization on the Transferee Property; and WHEREAS,it is contemplated that theTransferee'sNewBuildingwill containmore floor area development rights than are now available for use on the Transferee's Property, if considered a separate zoning lot, pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and the parties hereto therefore wish toutilize the procedure available pursuant to the ZoningResolution to make available the Subject Development Rights for utilization in connection with the construction and maintenance of Transferee's New Building, and Transferor is willing to make such Subject Development Rights available to Transferee in perpetuity; and WHEREAS, all Parties-In-Interest (as defined inSection 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution) to the Transferor's Property and Transferee's Property as shown on the Zoning Lot Certification of GOTHAM ABSTRACT & SETTLEMENT, LLC, as agent for Fidelity National Title Insurance Company, annexed hereto as Exhibit C, have executed the Declaration or waived their right to execute the Declaration and have subordinated their interest in the Transferor Property and Transferee Property, as the case may be, to the Declaration and to this Agreement to the extent set forth in the waivers and subordinations attached hereto in Exhibit D; and WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations and to the Zoning Lot and other matters; NOW,THEREFORE,in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreement contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of where are hereby conclusively acknowledged, the parties hereto hereby covenant and agree as follows: (1) Certain Definitions.As used herein: (a)“Additional Development Rights” shall mean any additional Floor Area Developinent Rights that may become available to the Transferee Premises or the Zoning Lot, (either by expansion of the Zoning Lot by adding Additional Parcels, by special permit, variance, or by any other procedure or transfer allowed under the provisions of the Zoning Resolution, including, without limitation, Sections 34-223, 35-35; 74-711; 74-79 et seq. and 23-90 et seq. thereof). (b)“Additional Parcel(s)” shall have the meaning set forth in Section 6 hereof. (c)“Agency(ies)”shall mean the New York City Planning Commission, the Department of City Planning of the City of New York, the City Council of the City of New York, the New York City Department of Buildings, the Board of Standards and Appeals of the City of New York, the Landmarks Preservation Commission, the Queens Borough President, any community board, any other municipal agencies, court or department, or any department, court or agency of the State of New York or the United States of America or any successor entity to any of the foregoing.
